source.author: stat
source.text: Tyriis ea causa colonis insomnem ludo certatim educere noctem suaserat; effusi passim per tecta, per agros, serta inter vacuosque mero crateras anhelum proflabant sub luce deum; tunc plurima buxus aeraque taurinos sonitu vincentia pulsus.
source.text_original: Tyriis ea causa colonis / insomnem ludo certatim educere noctem / suaserat; effusi passim per tecta, per agros, / serta inter vacuosque mero crateras anhelum / proflabant sub luce deum; tunc plurima buxus / aeraque taurinos sonitu vincentia pulsus.
source.text_english: For the Tyrian colonists that cause had advised them to spend the sleepless night in rival games; scattered everywhere over the roofs and fields, with garlands and empty mixing-bowls of wine, they were breathing out an eager prayer to the god in the light of day; then there was much boxwood and bronze, whose sound surpassed that of bulls, with beating.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hanc vero, socii, venientem litore laeti dulcibus alloquiis ludoque educite noctem.
reuse.text_original: hanc vero, socii, venientem litore laeti / dulcibus alloquiis ludoque educite noctem.
reuse.text_english: But this woman, comrades, as she comes ashore, cheer her through the night with sweet speeches and play.
